V_policy.eligibility: Positive paired composite mean vs incumbent and coords; no material estate degradation vs incumbent; incremental evidence against s012 across official, repeated and broader holds. Distinct mechanisms only.
V_policy.final_choice: Prefer balanced, simple candidate; require all estate noisy gains vs incumbent; reject material estate loss >0.015 vs selected checkpoint; do not fit ensemble weights to V. Tiny differences <0.01 treated uncertain.

quadrant_caveat: Legacy median-coordinate quadrants can split 80m blocks. Main region confirmation uses whole-block quadrants, weighted by tree population, plus 80m buffer. Sparse-tail unweighted occupied-block medians retained as extrapolation stress.

followup_batch.mechanism: Missing compact condition/structure families around s010 uniform core, jointly or bounded OOF; combined optical-pooling + local-SAR. Fixed inherited scales only. No subsequent V-driven family/weight tuning.
followup_batch.aligned_sar_pool: Retired without V: fresh10-repeat Palong mean degradation despite Serting gain.

selection_amendment: After V8, selected task-relative incumbent non-degradation and positive L estate means over s012; provisional .015 checkpoint guard failed Palong. Explicitly exploratory; no claim of preregistered incremental parent improvement.
final_confirmation: 20 reserved whole-block assignments completed after freeze; no subsequent model/V tuning.
